integrity: Infinite statements follow from a written constructive proof and edge-charging lower bound; finite checker corroborates small cases only. Novelty is judged against searched primary sources, with unindexed earlier work a residual risk; no independent audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: The exact \(2n-c\) bound is a worst-case result only for distinctly labelled open intervals of ply at most two and pairwise distinct endpoints. The width-two poset bound \(n+i(P)\) is constructive but need not be the minimum for each poset. No smoothness or Real-RAM extraction theorem is asserted.
title: Sharp component-sensitive sorting-supersequence bounds at ply two
